4351635.name: Chabad of Winchester
4351635.note: Washington Jewish Week, 12 Aug 2019 ('Jews of Winchester, Va., work to create a center for Jewish life', a copy on Beth El Congregation's site): 'Chabad comes to Winchester. Rabbi Yishai and Bluma Dinerman moved to Winchester in July'; 'The Dinermans moved here from Brooklyn, N.Y.' Before that they came for holidays: 'The Dinermans have been hosting holiday programs in Northern Virginia for about three years', and 'Two years ago they had a crazy experience in Winchester hosting a menorah lighting for Chanukah' (so about Chanukah 2017); the year here is the move. Its chabad.org listing went up 28 May 2019.

6442724.name: Chabad of Fredericksburg
6442724.note: Lubavitch.com, 6 Aug 2024 ('Chabad Brings "Audacious Hospitality" to Fredericksburg, Virginia', also on CrownHeights.info): 'Earlier this summer, Dr. Green got a call from a friend. Chabad would be coming to town'; developer Larry Silver and parents of University of Mary Washington students 'had asked Chabad of Virginia to invest in a Chabad on Campus branch at UMW. Rabbi Shaya and Mushky Gourarie answered that call. The young couple moved to town to lead the campus Jewish center built by Silver'; the Greens' 'first event' there was 'a Lag B'Omer barbecue' (Lag BaOmer fell on 26 May 2024). Its chabad.org listing went up 2 July 2024.

2953559.name: Chabad at George Mason University
2953559.note: Chabad.edu (Karen Schwartz) on CrownHeights.info, 29 July 2015 ('Chabad on Campus Welcomes 20 New Couples'): 'Rabbi Mendel Deitsch, 25, the emerging co-director of Chabad at George Mason University in Fairfax, Va., with his wife, Raizel'; 'especially for someone like me just starting out.' Its chabad.org listing went up 18 May 2015. New shluchim Rabbi Ezra and Bracha (Meisel) Wiemer took over in June 2022 (CrownHeights.info, 14 June 2022, https://crownheights.info/chabad-news/777737/new-shluchim-to-george-mason-university/).

4106868.name: Chabad of Loudoun County
4106868.note: Washington Jewish Week, 28 Apr 2021 ('Chabad of Loudoun County to launch Hebrew school'): 'The Cohens have had the idea for JUDA long before they founded Chabad of Loudoun in 2018' (co-directors Rabbi Chaim and Yehudis Cohen); 'When we moved here, everybody asked us, When are you opening up a Hebrew school?' Its chabad.org listing went up 29 Aug 2018.

7019796.name: Nova YJP
7019796.note: CrownHeights.info, 9 Apr 2025 ('35 New Shluchim Receive Grants, Fulfilling the Rebbe's Vision on His 123rd Birthday'): 'the next round of thirty-five new Shluchim couples who will be supported with seed grants'; 'Each of these couples is receiving seed funding from Keren Hashluchim to help establish new Chabad centers'; among them 'Rabbi Tzemach & Mrs. Hindy Lerman – Nova YJP, Fairfax, Virginia'. Its chabad.org listing went up 10 Sept 2025.
